fields.summary: Stock Management: Replace the GlobalProperties utility class
fields.description:
h3. Why

{{GlobalProperties}} is a 244-line class of 22 static methods that read the module's settings. 19 of them swallow every exception and return {{null}} or a default, so a mistyped or malformed setting fails silently. Its name clashes with core's {{GlobalProperty}}, and it duplicates what core's administration service already provides.

h3. Description

Read settings through core's {{AdministrationService}} and remove the utility class.

h3. Details

* Keep the 13 property-name constants, in a constants class.
* Replace each getter with core's typed {{getGlobalPropertyValue(key, defaultValue)}}, with the default stated at the call site or in one place per setting.
* A setting that cannot be parsed should be logged, not silently ignored.
* 44 call sites in 18 files use the class: the service, the scheduled jobs, the reports and two REST resources.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* No static settings utility remains.
* No setting read swallows an exception silently.
* Each setting keeps its current default.
* The build and all tests pass.
